name: io.github.borglayerdev/borglayer-mcp
description: The BorgLayer API for AI agents: search & register domains, transfer domains in, manage DNS, set registrant details, and form US LLCs — paid from a prepaid USDC account balance.

authentication.instructions: Get a BorgLayer API key at https://borglayer.com and top up its prepaid USDC balance. Pass it as Authorization: Bearer blrk_... Each tool is scoped; register/transfer/formation debit the balance.

tools.name: search_domains
tools.description: Search available domains, priced for your account

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List the domains registered on your account

tools.name: list_chains
tools.description: Supported chains + stablecoins for funding, each with its verified escrow contract

tools.name: register_domain
tools.description: Register an available domain (debits balance; scope domains.register)

tools.name: transfer_in_domain
tools.description: Transfer a domain in from another registrar with its auth/EPP code (scope domains.transfer)

tools.name: list_dns
tools.description: List a domain's DNS records (scope dns.read)

tools.name: delete_dns_record
tools.description: Delete a DNS record by id (scope dns.write)

tools.name: create_registrant_profile
tools.description: Create a registrant profile — real owner data required for ccTLDs (scope registrant.write)

tools.name: delete_registrant_profile
tools.description: Delete a registrant profile by id (scope registrant.write)

tools.name: formation_quote
tools.description: Price a US LLC / entity formation with optional EIN + BOI (scope formation.read)

tools.name: create_formation
tools.description: Form a US LLC / entity; debits balance then files (scope formation.write)

tools.name: get_formation
tools.description: Status of a formation order by reference (scope formation.read)
